about.en: MCDon is the Ondo tokenized stock for McDonald's, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by MCD shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x4C82c8cD9a218612DCe60b156B73A36705645e3b, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
